section_path: 7 Sensitivity Analysis

note:
Coverage. All 27 physical pages were read at text level and every one of the 23 measured regions was inspected on a crop. The paper's text layer is complete except for three pasted equations (p9, and the two display strips on p10/p14 that are typeset), so quotes resolve everywhere else. No page is a screenshot of a page. 

The filing habit. This is the first paper in the lane whose region count and exhibit count agree, and the reason is mechanical: 21 of 23 regions are the 21 printed exhibits, because the paper typesets its mathematics as text and only three equations were dropped in as images. Compare the two previous papers, where 14 and 5 captioned exhibits owned no measured region at all. The lesson for the census: a 1:1 result is not evidence of a better detector, it is evidence that the paper's equations were set with the same tool as its captions. 

Caption geography. The side rule is perfect - 16 figures below, 5 tables above - but the table side has a twist worth carrying: the caption sits inside the grid. Table 1's caption prints between the double top rule and the header row, so the text layer's line reads 'Symbol   Table 1: Notations / Description' and the caption is the middle of a three-part header. Tables 2-5 print their captions above the frame in the ordinary way. Captions are also fused twice (Figures 11/12 on one line on p19, Figures 13/14 on one line on p20) and hyphenated twice (Figure 12's 'sta-', Figure 7's 'supercharg-'), which is the same twin-caption fault the previous three papers showed, arriving here in a paper that otherwise files perfectly. 

Two exotic charts and no vocabulary for them. Figure 3 is a two-ring doughnut with callout labels and a three-line abbreviation key, Figure 5 is a three-circle Venn with a text key, and neither has a home in the fourteen-family list, so both are recorded as other with a note. Together with the radar chart mcm-d0's #268 reported, that is three exotic types in four papers: the vocabulary is now the binding constraint on the family field, not the papers' imagination. 

Placement is where this paper actually fails. Figure 3 prints at the top of p11, between the second and third bullets of the list that introduces Figure 4, so a reader following 'There are three types of routes' is thrown into a charging-station doughnut and back out again, and the list's second bullet is separated from its first by an entire exhibit. Figure 3 also has no pointer anywhere in 27 pages. Figures 11 and 12 are paired in one row but come from two different basemap technologies - one a vector flow map with glowing edges, the other a screenshot of five hundred pins - with no shared projection, no shared symbol scale, and captions that share one line, so the 'comparison' is a layout decision rather than a comparison. 

The tables. Three booktabs grids (Tables 1, 3, 4) and two closed boxes (Tables 2, 5), and the split is not stylistic drift: the boxed pair is exactly the pair with merged cells on two axes, a unit inside the header and decimal-aligned values, i.e. the two tables whose columns are a nested classification rather than a plain 2-D array. Nothing has zebra shading, a diagonal header, a continued row or a landscape turn, and nothing overflows the 425 pt measure - the narrowest grid in the lane so far. Two faults worth keeping: Table 2 and Table 5 print the identical caption four pages apart, and Table 4's printed grid drops the stub beside 0.125 and 0.175 so the text layer detaches two values from their row. 

A one-item sensitivity analysis. Section 7 plots three lambda values over 40 time units and concludes the proportion is less sensitive to lambda early on, and it is the paper's only sensitivity exhibit - a single line chart, no table, no grid of cases. The caption orders the lambdas 0.3, 0.27, 0.33 while the key orders them 0.3, 0.33, 0.27, so the reader who trusts the caption and the reader who trusts the legend disagree about which curve is which; the swatch colours are the only real key. 

Apparatus limits worth keeping. The red Taobao banner prints across the top of all 27 pages, so every page that opens with a box still reads as caption_above and the banner text enters any 'text above the first exhibit' heuristic. The running header 'Team # 82794  Page N of 24' is offset from the physical page by two (physical p11 prints 'Page 8 of 24'), so printed and physical pagination disagree throughout. The appendix opens with the literal placeholder 'some more text' welded to a red run-in 'Input C++ source:', and its code listing carries no caption at all - the only uncaptioned object in the document that is not an equation.
rules: 27 pages, 23 measured regions on 15 of them, and 21 of those regions are the paper's 21 printed exhibits (Figures 1-16, Tables 1-5) - the cleanest 1:1 census in this lane so far [place.doc_order].
The two non-exhibits are p9's pasted equation (6) and p26's appendix opener; nothing else measures because every other display equation is typeset text with no vector strokes [place.area_frac].
Exhibits are spread thin: thirteen pages carry the 21 rows, no page carries more than three, seven pages carry exactly one and six carry two or three [place.page_order].

Areas are small and even: mean 8.3 per cent of the page, maximum 18.3 per cent (Figure 2), and the four smallest are the 3.5-4.1 per cent half-measure panels of Figures 11-14 [place.area_frac].
Eighteen of the 21 rows are pointed at by some phrase, but only eleven by NUMBER (Figures 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 13, 14, 15 and Tables 1, 2, 3) [mention.style].

Lead patterns: none 10, as-shown-in 9, direct 1, figure-n-shows 1 - the 'as shown in Figure N' formula is the paper's default pointer [mention.lead_pattern].

Unlabelled leads are long and carry the modelling step rather than the reading: 'Apply the ratio of vehicle possession to equation 4 to get the number of distribution for each city:' [mention.lead_sentence].
Caption side never wavers: all 16 figure captions below their art, all 5 table captions above their grid [caption.position].
Numbering is one form only, 'Figure N:' and 'Table N:', with a colon and a space; there is no parenthetical, no bare number-only label, and no 'Fig.' abbreviation anywhere [caption.numbering].
Captions are 3 to 18 words, one sentence, and never carry a unit, a variable, a condition or a conclusion [caption.words].
Voice is none on all 21 rows: not one caption uses an active verb ('Figure 4 shows ...') or a passive one ('... is shown in Figure 4') - each is a bare noun phrase [caption.voice].
Table captions are set as the top row of the grid, inside the top rule for Table 1 and above the frame for Tables 2-5, so the text layer prints the caption on the header line [caption.verbatim].

Three captions are fused or damaged: Figures 11 and 12 share one printed line on p19, Figures 13 and 14 share one on p20, and Figure 3's caption line runs straight into the next bullet [caption.sentences].
Figure 12's caption hyphenates 'sta-' across the line break and Figure 7's hyphenates 'supercharg-' - both are the typesetter's breaks, not the authors' wording [caption.verbatim].

Families: node-link-network 4, line 4, map-or-plan-view 3, bar 2, other 2, flowchart-or-schematic 1 - and both 'other' rows are textbook exotic charts, a nested doughnut (Figure 3) and a three-circle Venn diagram (Figure 5) [geometry.family].
No row is 3-D, no row is a contour and exactly one row carries a colourbar (Figure 10's 0-1400 marker ramp, floating inside the map) [geometry.three_d].

Legends: none 5, inside 4, outside-right 3, below 2, outside-left 1, above 1 - and the two 'below' keys are a doughnut's abbreviation list and a diverging bar's two-swatch key under the mirrored axis [geometry.legend].

Every row is a single panel; not one exhibit composes sub-panels, and the side-by-side pairs (Figures 11/12, 13/14, 5/6 of the earlier papers) are separate measured regions here [geometry.panel_count].

Shared axes are false on all 21 rows even where the pair obviously wants them: Figures 13 and 14 do share the same ranges (t 50-300, y 0-1) by hand, but Figures 11 and 12 share neither projection nor symbol scale [geometry.shared_axes].
Printed numbers appear on 7 rows and are absent on 9; the maps and the network schemata print none at all [geometry.printed_numbers].

Data labels are rare and machine-generated - three line charts print coordinate pairs at their plateaus, (36,1) (108,1) then (47,1) (39,1) (54,1) (323,1), and no other row labels a data point [geometry.data_labels].

Table rule styles split 3 booktabs, 2 boxed, 0 vertical-rules, 0 no-rules: Tables 1, 3 and 4 use top-header-bottom and nothing else, while Tables 2 and 5 are closed frames with every internal rule drawn [table.rule_style].

The two boxed grids are exactly the two with merged cells on both axes and the two with a unit inside the header ('number(million)', 'number(thousand)') and the two with decimal-aligned values - one stylistic package, used twice [table.merged_cells].
No grid has zebra shading, a diagonal header cell, a continued table or a landscape orientation; all five are portrait, 3 to 4 rows and 2 to 4 columns [table.zebra].
Widths run 353, 368, 368, 377 and 388 pt inside a 425 pt measure, so every grid is 'full' and none overflows - a marked contrast to the previous paper's two overruns [table.width].

Table 2 and Table 5 print the SAME caption word for word ('the number of charging stations'), four pages and one country apart, so a printed table title cannot identify a grid in this paper either [table.note_sentence].

One pointer is wrong: 'The result is as shown in Table 3.' follows the paragraph about the DESTINATION distribution while Table 3 prints the SUPERCHARGING one [mention.count].
The red Taobao banner prints at the top of all 27 pages, text pages and image pages alike [place.area_frac].
No exhibit is captioned twice, none is numbered out of order, and the figure count runs 1-16 without a gap - the numbering is the cleanest thing about the paper's apparatus [caption.numbering].
